div.div:
How to read
1. Follow the solid arrows from left to right through the core process.
2. The orange/red boxes are the four main system views.
3. The blue lens boxes apply across those views and improve judgment throughout the process.
4. Dashed blue arrows show evidence-driven iteration; dashed red arrows show reframing from environmental discovery.
